headings.notes: Use for H1, H2, H3. Ensure tight letter spacing.

body.notes: Use for paragraphs, bios, and descriptions.

labels.notes: Use for tags, overlines, and small metadata.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for the Age Gate overlay and sticky nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/10). Deep solid dark for Bento cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain texture overlay to the entire page to kill 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient black shadows. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] for depth.

age_gate.style: Full viewport fixed overlay (z-[100]). Deep black frosted glass (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/95). Centered elegant prompt. 'Enter' button should be solid gold (#D4AF37) with black text. 'Exit' ghost button.

hero.layout: Min-h-screen. Full bleed background image. Overlay: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/60 to-transparent. Left-aligned or Optical-centered typography. Huge H1 'Alexa Grey'.

quick_facts.layout: Bento Grid Mode A (Asymmetrical). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3. Border-collapse style or individual cards with 1px gold-tinted borders. Dark surface.

about_me.layout: Split layout. Left: Tall elegant portrait. Right: Confident, sensual bio text. Spacing: py-24 px-8.

services_tags.layout: Flex wrap, gap-3. Tags are pill-shaped: rounded-full border border-[#D4AF37]/30 text-[#EED891] bg-black/40 px-4 py-2 text-sm. Hover: bg-[#D4AF37]/10.

availability_rates.layout: Two side-by-side bento cards. Clean un-cluttered rows. 1px border-b border-white/5 for separators. Prices right-aligned in gold.

media_gallery.layout: Masonry or 3-column grid. Initially blurred: filter: blur(24px) scale(1.05). Overlay container with 'Reveal Media' button. When opted in, blur animates to 0.

booking_form.layout: Minimalist inputs. bg-transparent, border-b border-white/20, focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none. No heavy card wrappers. Submit button: Gold pill.

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. p-8, p-12, py-24. Use large negative spaces to evoke exclusivity.
layouts.alignment: Avoid center-everything. Use optical left alignment for text to establish a sophisticated editorial feel.
layouts.grids: Use the Tetris bento grid for stats. Avoid equal squares.

motion.hover: Interactive elements should have a subtle gold glow or -translate-y-1. transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.
motion.scroll: Staggered fade-up for gallery and bento items as they enter viewport.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds passes APCA. Gold text on black is generally high contrast.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs must have a clear focus state (e.g., border-color change to gold).

hero_bg.description: Sensual brunette woman with a black shawl, dark moody lighting.

about_photo.description: Stylish woman in black coat posing confidently outdoors during twilight.

gallery_1.description: Alluring woman in black underwear in darkness.

gallery_2.description: Stylish portrait of a woman wearing a wide-brimmed black hat.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for elegant, slow, sultry reveal animations, fade-ins, and the blur removal transition on the gallery. Do not use heavy 3D like Three.js to keep the site feeling like a fast, high-end editorial.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are writing .js files. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Import Cormorant Garamond and Manrope fonts from Google Fonts in index.css.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page structural sections to allow asymmetrical bento grids.
Use Shadcn only for the Form inputs, and heavily customize them to strip out the 'Vercel' look. Form inputs should look like elegant under-lined text fields.

For the blurred gallery, use CSS backdrop-filter or filter: blur() on the image container. Maintain a state variable `isOptedIn` (boolean) to toggle the class. Render a lock icon over the blurred content.
The Age Verification gate must block scrolling (overflow-hidden on body) and interaction until 'Enter' is clicked.
Never use pure white or pure black. Use #F5F5F0 for white text, and #050505 for background.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements. Example: data-testid='booking-submit-btn'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the deep luxury aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid darks with subtle noise or vignette.
Do not center everything. Emphasize asymmetry and tension in layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-xl).
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
No AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
